q1: SELECT DISTINCT F.ORIGIN_CITY, F.DEST_CITY, F.ACTUAL_TIME FROM FLIGHTS AS F JOIN (SELECT A.ORIGIN_CITY, MAX(A.ACTUAL_TIME) AS MAX_TIME FROM FLIGHTS AS A GROUP BY A.ORIGIN_CITY) AS X ON F.ORIGIN_CITY = X.ORIGIN_CITY AND F.ACTUAL_TIME = X.MAX_TIME
q2: SELECT P.ORIGIN_CITY, P.DEST_CITY, P.ACTUAL_TIME FROM (SELECT F1.ORIGIN_CITY, F1.DEST_CITY, F1.ACTUAL_TIME, MAX(F2.ACTUAL_TIME) AS MAX_ACTUAL_TIME FROM FLIGHTS AS F1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS F2 ON F1.ORIGIN_CITY = F2.ORIGIN_CITY GROUP BY F1.ORIGIN_CITY, F1.DEST_CITY, F1.ACTUAL_TIME) AS P WHERE P.ACTUAL_TIME = P.MAX_ACTUAL_TIME

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT P.ORIGIN_CITY, P.DEST_CITY, P.ACTUAL_TIME FROM (SELECT F1.ORIGIN_CITY, F1.DEST_CITY, F1.ACTUAL_TIME, MAX(F2.ACTUAL_TIME) AS MAX_ACTUAL_TIME FROM FLIGHTS AS F1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS F2 ON F1.ORIGIN_CITY = F2.ORIGIN_CITY GROUP BY F1.ORIGIN_CITY, F1.DEST_CITY, F1.ACTUAL_TIME) AS P WHERE P.ACTUAL_TIME = P.MAX_ACTUAL_TIME
counterexample: INSERT INTO FLIGHTS (FID, ORIGIN_CITY, DEST_CITY, ACTUAL_TIME) VALUES (1, 101, 201, 1500), (2, 101, 202, 1500), (3, 102, 203, 1500);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 selects the destination city for the flight with the latest actual time from each origin city, while Q2 selects the destination city for the flight with the latest actual time from each origin city and destination city pair.
counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when there are multiple flights with the same latest actual time from the same origin city, but to different destination cities.
